_comment: Chapter 10's thresholds and vocabulary. The activity names are Learn's (Microsoft Entra audit log categories and activities, Core Directory, ApplicationManagement), read on October 30, 2026; the thresholds marked design are the program's (Design guidance). The pipeline's own service principals are tenant data and come from -PipelineIdentitiesPath, never from this file.
expiringDaysSource: Learn: the Renew expiring application credentials recommendation (preview) flags credentials expiring within the next 30 days
unusedDaysSource: Learn: the Remove unused applications recommendation (preview) flags apps not used for over 90 days
maxWindowDaysSource: Learn: Microsoft Entra audit logs are kept 30 days with P1 or P2, seven days on Free
ownerReviewDaysSource: design: the plan's N7.2 asks for a quarterly owners' permission review
attestationDaysSource: design: Learn's agent best practices say sponsors attest every six to twelve months; the code holds the longer bound and the program's policy may shorten it
maxAgentAssignmentDaysSource: design: Book 17, Chapter 05 never creates agent access without an end date; the maximum by risk tier is the program's decision (research gaps, row 97)
